jobs.title: Content Creator Intern
jobs.description:
***ABOUT THE ROLE***

We're looking for someone who loves creating content and enjoys bringing ideas to life through video. As our Creative Content Intern / Freelancer based in Singapore, you'll work closely with the Marketing team to storyboard, film, edit and produce engaging content for our social media channels.

You'll create content that showcases Helpling's services, tells authentic customer and provider stories, and brings our brand to life across digital platforms. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of content from concept to execution, bringing fresh ideas and seeing them come to life.

This is a 3\\-month part\\-time / full\\-time contract role ideal for someone looking to build their portfolio, gain hands\\-on experience, and make a visible impact in a fast\\-moving startup environment.

***KEY RESPONSIBILITIES***

1\\) Content Creation

* Plan, storyboard and produce engaging short\\-form content for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and YouTube Shorts.
* Film on\\-site at customer homes, company events or other approved locations when required.
* Edit videos with engaging pacing, captions, music and transitions suitable for social media.
* Design simple supporting graphics and creative assets where required.

2\\) Creative Ideation

* Research social media trends, viral content formats and creator best practices.
* Brainstorm fresh content ideas that align with Helpling's brand and marketing campaigns.
* Suggest new ways to increase audience engagement through creative storytelling.

3\\) Social Media Support

* Support the preparation and scheduling of content across social media platforms.
* Assist with basic community engagement and content optimisation where required.

4\\) Team Collaboration

* Work closely with the Marketing team and other internal stakeholders to coordinate content shoots.
* Ensure content aligns with brand guidelines and campaign objectives.
* Support other marketing initiatives and creative projects as required.

***SUCCESS PROFILE***

You'll thrive in this role if you're naturally curious and creative, and enjoy bringing ideas to life through engaging content. You have a strong eye for trends and storytelling, take initiative, and are excited to experiment with new formats to create content that resonates with audiences.

You're organised, adaptable, and comfortable receiving feedback to continuously improve your work. Most importantly, you enjoy creating content that people genuinely want to watch and are excited by the opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast\\-paced startup environment.

***REQUIREMENTS***

* Passion for creating engaging digital content, with a strong eye for storytelling, visual composition and social media trends.
* Confident planning, filming and editing short\\-form videos for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
* Proficiency in video editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent.
* Basic design skills using Canva; familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator or After Effects) is an advantage.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Self\\-motivated, proactive and comfortable taking ownership in a fast\\-paced startup environment.
* Students, fresh graduates, freelancers or individuals building a career in content creation are encouraged to apply.
* Based in Singapore

***PORTFOLIO***

Please include examples of videos, social media content or creative work you've produced (personal projects, freelance work, internships or school assignments are all welcome). We care more about your creativity and ability to tell compelling stories than the number of years you've worked.

Pay: $1,500\\.00 \\- $1,800\\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Location:

* Singapore (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Singapore (Singapore, Singapore)

jobs.title: Account Executive (1 year contract)
jobs.description:
**About WPP Production**



We are WPP Production \\- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.


**About WPP**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting\\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\\-class creativity, next\\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

**What does Account Executive do at WPP Production?**


*As an Account Executive, you will support the account management team in delivering high\\-quality client service, coordinating projects, and ensuring smooth execution of campaigns.*


**Key****Responsibilities**


* *Support the Account Management team in managing day\\-to\\-day client communications and project coordination*
* *Prepare project status reports, and follow\\-ups to ensure alignment across clients and internal teams*
* *Assist in developing clear and concise briefs for creative, strategy, and production teams*
* *Track project timelines, deliverables, and budgets to ensure on\\-time and on\\-scope delivery*
* *Utilize AI tools (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, workflow tools) to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual processes*
* *Use AI\\-driven solutions across campaign execution, reporting, and internal workflows*
* *Coordinate with cross\\-functional teams (creative, media, production, tech) to ensure seamless execution*
* *Monitor campaign performance and compile reports with actionable insights*
* *Manage administrative tasks including documentation, invoicing coordination, and project tracking*

**Requirements**


* *Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field*
* *Min 1 year or prior internship experience in account servicing, marketing, or advertising agency environment*
* *Practical experience using AI tools to support workflow optimization, operations, or campaign execution*
* *Strong organizational and multitasking skills with attention to detail*
* *Excellent written and verbal communication skills*
* *Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\\-paced, deadline\\-driven environment*
* *Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and adopt new technologies*

**Why work here:**  

At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\\-class talent, cutting\\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.


**Inclusion and Impact**  

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  

  

**Data**

Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
